feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 361 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 40 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Auto Glass Bid Calculator — Windshield, ADAS Calibration, Mobile Fee
entry.summary: Price a windshield or door-glass replacement from glass source, ADAS camera/sensor calibration, mobile trip fee, and cash vs. insurance billing — and get warned before you send a bid that forgot to price the calibration.

entry.title: Auto Loan Interest Deduction Calculator — 2026 QPVLI Estimator, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the new federal auto loan interest deduction (One Big Beautiful Bill Act, tax years 2025-2028): applies the $10,000 cap, the $200-per-$1,000 MAGI phase-out, and the 8-item new/US-assembled/personal-use/first-lien eligibility checklist -- including the MFS treatment most people get wrong. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Backup File Exposure Checker — Is Your backup.zip or .sql Dump Public?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste your site's URL and it sends real GET requests to eight well-known backup filenames (backup.zip, backup.tar.gz, backup.sql, db.sql, and more), verifying the response against a real archive's magic bytes or a real SQL dump's line shape -- not just an HTTP status -- to name whether your deployment is publicly serving a full site or database backup. Never reads row data out of a matched SQL dump, never extracts a matched archive. Nothing uploaded to us.

entry.title: Claude Code Settings Check — find hooks that never fire and permission rules that never match
entry.summary: Paste a Claude Code settings.json (and, optionally, settings.local.json) and get every structural mistake flagged: a hook matcher that can't compile, a hook with no command, a misspelled event name, a permission rule with unbalanced parentheses, a rule duplicated across allow/deny/ask, and a rule that contradicts itself across the two files. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Claude Skill Scaffold Generator — turn a plain-language description into a starter SKILL.md
entry.summary: Type what a Claude Agent Skill should do and when Claude should use it, plus any scripts, references, or assets it bundles, and get a starter SKILL.md with valid YAML frontmatter and a suggested folder layout -- checked for the common authoring mistakes that keep a skill from triggering. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded, no model call.

entry.title: Cloud Bucket Exposure Checker — is your S3/GCS/Azure bucket publicly listable?
entry.summary: Free tool: run a CLI that sends one real, read-only request to an AWS S3 bucket, a Google Cloud Storage bucket, or an Azure Blob container you name, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on whether anyone on the internet can list its contents with no credentials. Never fetches an object's own content, only the listing. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Depop Fee Calculator — What You Actually Keep After Depop's Fee
entry.summary: Free Depop seller fee calculator for the US and UK schedule (0% selling fee, 3.3%+$0.45 or 2.9%+£0.30 processing on item price + shipping) and the rest-of-world flat 10% schedule, plus Boosted Listings. Real profit, price for a target profit, and a region-by-region comparison. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Economic Nexus Threshold Tracker — Which States Have You Crossed?
entry.summary: Free browser tracker for online and multi-channel sellers: enter trailing-12-month gross sales and transaction count by state, and see which states' economic-nexus sales-tax-registration thresholds you've crossed, per state, against each state's own published $100k/$250k/$500k and 200-transaction figures. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Employee vs. Contractor Cost Calculator
entry.summary: Free calculator comparing the fully-loaded cost of a W-2 employee against a 1099 contractor for the same role — FICA, capped FUTA/SUTA, workers' comp, PTO, benefits, payroll admin, and one-time onboarding, plus the contractor rate at which the two cost the same. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Hidden Unicode Check — find invisible and bidi characters in a file
entry.summary: Paste CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, copilot-instructions.md, a README, or any text and find zero-width characters, Unicode tag characters, and bidirectional (RLO/LRO) override characters hidden from human review -- the technique behind current AI-agent prompt-injection attacks and Trojan Source. Free, private, runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: Kubernetes Resource Limits Check — What Can Take Down a Node
entry.summary: Paste or load Kubernetes manifest YAML and get a deterministic report of every container missing a memory limit, memory request, CPU request, or ephemeral-storage limit -- the specific gaps that let one container starve or crowd out everything else on its node -- plus any request set above its own limit, which kubectl apply rejects outright. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Kickstarter Fee Calculator — What a Funded Campaign Actually Keeps
entry.summary: Free Kickstarter fee calculator. 5% platform fee plus per-pledge processing (3% + $0.20 standard, 5% + $0.05 under $10) -- see why more, smaller pledges keep less of the same total raised. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: LLM API Pricing Calculator — compare Claude, GPT, Gemini token costs
entry.summary: Compare the monthly dollar cost of calling different LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, or a custom provider) for your own workload -- modelling fresh input, cached input, and output tokens separately, since cached tokens are billed far below fresh input and usually dominate agentic workloads. Free, private, no signup.

entry.title: MCP Config Risk Check — audit an mcp.json for risky server settings
entry.summary: Paste an mcp.json, claude_desktop_config.json, or any MCP server config and get every risky pattern flagged: servers granted broad filesystem/shell access, API keys hardcoded instead of referenced from env, missing version pins, and duplicate tool names across servers. Free, private, runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: Mega Backdoor Roth 401(k) Calculator — After-Tax Contribution Headroom
entry.summary: Free browser calculator for the mega backdoor Roth 401(k) strategy: enter your YTD elective deferral, employer contributions, and after-tax contributions and get your remaining after-tax headroom under the 2025/2026 IRS 415(c) limit, plus the per-paycheck amount to use it up by year-end. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: S-Corp Reasonable Compensation Calculator — Salary vs. Distribution
entry.summary: Free browser calculator for single-shareholder S-corp owners: compare your planned W-2 salary against a comparable-wage figure you supply, see the FICA-tax cost of closing the gap, and get a printable nine-factor documentation checklist for your own records. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Salary Range Posting Check — Does Your Job Ad Have One?
entry.summary: Paste a job posting and pick the states it could be filled from. Instantly see whether the text appears to state a pay range, and which of those states currently require one by law, with the effective date and size threshold cited. Free, runs entirely in your browser — not legal advice.

entry.title: Skill Manifest Check — lint a SKILL.md before it ships
entry.summary: Paste a SKILL.md file (the format Claude Code and similar agent systems use) and get every common authoring mistake flagged: missing or malformed frontmatter, a description too vague to trigger reliably, overlapping triggers across sibling skills, and a body-size caution against a context budget. Free SKILL.md linter and Claude skill checker, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Slopsquatting Check — Did an AI Assistant Just Suggest a Package That Doesn't Exist?
entry.summary: Paste your package.json and this offline check flags any dependency name that looks like a one- or two-letter typo of a famous npm package -- the same shape as a hallucinated name an AI coding assistant invents. Get the free CLI for the live check: does this name exist on the registry at all, and if it does, was it published suspiciously recently? No account, no upload.

entry.title: STR Occupancy Tax Calculator
entry.summary: Split a short-term rental stay's occupancy tax into what Airbnb or Vrbo already collects and what is left for the host to remit directly, layer by layer -- state, county, city, and a flat per-night fee. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Tip Pool Compliance Calculator
entry.summary: Check a mandatory tip pool against federal FLSA rules: managers and supervisors are never eligible, and back-of-house staff are eligible only if you take no tip credit. See the tip-credit back-wage exposure a non-compliant pool creates. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Window Tinting Bid Calculator — Auto Tint Job Pricing
entry.summary: Free bid calculator for independent auto window tinting installers: price a vehicle film job by which windows are being tinted, film tier, waste factor, and old-tint removal — then see the gap against a flat per-vehicle price for the same job.

entry.title: GitHub Actions secrets: inherit Check — Reusable Workflow Secret Exposure
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every secrets: inherit call that hands your whole secret set to an external reusable workflow, or to a job a fork can trigger. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Docker Base Image EOL Check — Is Your FROM Line Still Supported?
entry.summary: Paste your Dockerfile and find every FROM line whose base image release has passed its own end-of-life date. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Dotenv Exposure Checker — Is Your .env File Publicly Readable?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste your site's URL and it sends real GET requests to .env, .env.local, .env.production, and two other well-known dotenv filenames, verifying the response body actually looks like a real KEY=VALUE file -- not just an HTTP status -- to name whether your deployment is publicly serving its own environment-variable secrets. Reports key NAMES only, never values. Nothing uploaded to us.

entry.title: Firebase Security Rules Exposure Checker — Is Your Database Public?
entry.summary: Free, in-browser tool: enter your Firebase project ID (plus its Realtime Database URL and/or Firestore collection names) and it sends real, read-only, unauthenticated requests, naming which paths return real data with no login -- the default-open / left-in-test-mode security rules exposure documented since Appthority's 2018 Firebase mismanagement report. Nothing uploaded to us.

entry.title: Upwork vs. Fiverr Fee Calculator — What You Actually Keep
entry.summary: Free calculator comparing Upwork and Fiverr net payout for the same job price, after platform fees, withdrawal fees, and a tax reserve. Solve for the price to charge on either platform to hit a take-home goal.

entry.title: Git Exposure Checker — is your .git directory publicly readable?
entry.summary: Free tool: run a CLI that sends two real requests to your site (.git/HEAD and .git/config), then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on whether your .git directory is publicly exposed -- letting anyone reconstruct your full source history, including secrets removed in a later commit. Correctly tells a real exposure apart from a 200-status soft-404 page. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: GraphQL Introspection Exposure Checker — Is Your Schema Public?
entry.summary: Free tool: sends one real introspection query to a GraphQL endpoint URL you choose and reports whether introspection is enabled -- exposing every query, mutation, and type name, including ones no client links to. Runs in your browser when the target's CORS policy allows it, or via a zero-dependency CLI. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Mercari Fee Calculator — What You Actually Keep After the 10% Fee
entry.summary: Free Mercari seller fee calculator for the current schedule (10% on item price + buyer-paid shipping, effective Jan 6 2025) and the legacy pre-2025 schedule (10% on item price plus 2.9%+$0.50 processing). Real profit, price for a target profit, and which schedule pays more. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: OSHA TRIR & DART Rate Calculator
entry.summary: Free OSHA TRIR and DART rate calculator: turn your OSHA 300 log's recordable case count and total hours worked into the two rates GC prequalification forms and insurance renewals ask for, and see how many injury-free hours it takes to hit a target rate. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Personal Trainer Package Pricing Calculator — Package vs. Pay-Per-Session, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent personal trainers: compares a discounted prepaid session package against pay-per-session pricing on net take-home pay per hour, after your gym or studio's percentage cut or flat facility fee — not just revenue. A flat per-session fee erodes a discounted package harder than it erodes full price, and a makeup-owed policy can turn a package's guaranteed revenue into a worse hourly rate. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Podcast Feed Validator — Apple Podcasts / RSS 2.0 Spec Checker
entry.summary: Free tool: paste your podcast's RSS feed XML and check it against the documented Apple Podcasts feed requirements and the RSS 2.0 spec -- missing title/description/language/category/explicit/artwork, an invalid pubDate format, a missing atom:link rel=self, and duplicate episode guids (the documented cause of an episode reappearing as new or disappearing from a podcast app). A zero-dependency CLI fetches your feed URL for real. Runs in your browser or as a CI check. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Sign Language Interpreter Rate Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free rate calculator for freelance ASL/sign language interpreters. Price a single assignment from hours, the 2-hour booking minimum, portal-to-portal travel, mileage, an after-hours/weekend/holiday differential, and a team-interpreting flag for long legal/medical/mental-health bookings — plus a late-cancellation fee calculator. Entirely client-side.

entry.title: Source Map Leak Checker — Is Your Production JS Exposing Original Source?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste your site's URL (or a list of JS file URLs), and it finds every script's sourceMappingURL comment, fetches the map, and names which ones are publicly readable and whether they embed full original source text. Nothing uploaded to us.

entry.title: Subdomain Takeover Checker — Is Your CNAME Dangling?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste a hostname and it follows its real CNAME chain, then -- if the chain ends at a known takeover-prone provider (S3, Heroku, GitHub Pages, Azure, and 20 more) -- sends one live GET request and checks the response against that provider's own 'nothing is claimed at this name' page. Confirms a dangling CNAME with live evidence, not just a DNS guess. Nothing uploaded to us.

entry.title: Supabase RLS Exposure Checker — Is Your Anon Key Reading Real Rows?
entry.summary: Free, in-browser tool: paste your Supabase project URL and anon key, and it sends a real read-only request to every table it can see, naming which ones return real rows to an unauthenticated request -- the CVE-2025-48757 missing-RLS exposure class. Nothing uploaded to us.

entry.title: Turo Host Payout Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free Turo host payout calculator. Turo's host share now depends on your earnings plan (Peace of Mind, Balanced, More Earnings) AND how far ahead the guest books — this tool models the whole matrix, compares all three plans and all four booking windows for the same trip, and projects a monthly estimate. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Voice-Over Project Rate Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free voice-over rate calculator for freelance VO artists. Price a commercial, e-learning, IVR, or explainer script per word or per finished minute, scaled by usage/licensing term (internal, web, broadcast, buyout) — or price an audiobook per finished hour from manuscript word count. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Dimensional Weight Calculator
entry.summary: Work out the billable weight of a parcel from its box size, weight and DIM divisor — then see the box size that stops you paying for air, and whether the carton trips an additional-handling or oversize surcharge.
